news.analysis: It's a brutal loss for the Ravens and fantasy managers depending on Lamar's return. news.contents: Baltimore Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson (thumb) could miss the remainder of the 2026 season after head coach Jesse Minter confirmed he needs surgery, according to NFL Network's Tom Pelissero.
